Question: I would like to know if we can keep the girls name malika, which means queen? Jazakallah Answer ID: 258 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 406/J) There no fault in naming a babygirl as Malika . You may keep this name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
